text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having broken free from her negative 
feelings toward Duramente, Kitasan Black 
trained diligently with her eyes set on 
winning the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even when disheartened, Kitasan Black 
possesses an unwavering core— Cheval Grand 
wanted to see that strength for herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To look at others and understand her own 
strengths... She reveals her intention to 
enter a race to her Trainer for the first 
time—she wants to run in the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her Trainer, overjoyed by Cheval Grand's 
newfound determination, intensified their 
training at a rapid pace for the big GⅠ 
stage.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—Without the heavy favorite Duramente, who 
had to sit out due to injury, the final 
race of the Classic Triple Crown begins.
